candidate: Clip raw Rows to each selected source segment, collect only selected rows into an exactly preallocated vector, preserve the original formatter and owner rearm API.
profile: release; thin LTO; codegen-units=1; no custom RUSTFLAGS
isolation: Both measured binaries built serially in /tmp/rustty-capture-1d9a51623 with identical isolated workspace, lock and compiler; only capture.rs changed between builds. The test module is cfg(test). Isolated workspace manifests are archived.
quiet_window: All binaries built before measurements; other agents held CPU-heavy work for each of the two 12-process windows.

rejected_trial.reason: Formatting directly from lazy row iterators consistently slowed full-history controls by about 7–10%; selected-range preallocated vector retained instead.

validation.baseline_regression: Both cold-ownership tests fail on unchanged capture; visible/alternate reads grow source page storage 549893→4249093 bytes. All 3 new regressions pass on candidate.

fixture_differential.description: Explicit probe copy of existing capture_reference.rs; RUSTTY_CAPTURE_DIFFERENTIAL records Rust output for every original selected fixture option, including modern flags unsupported by system tmux.

older_c_reference.excluded_flags: L,F,H,I explicitly skipped by the C 3.6 probe; original groups fail on unsupported flags. This is not a full modern C-reference pass.
preexisting_byte_differences: Styled-tab overwrite -pe: Rustty retains background SGR that 3.6 omits.
Tab reflow -N: Rustty retains one allocated trailing blank that 3.6 omits.
older_c_reference.baseline_proof: Both byte differences reproduced directly with unchanged baseline binary; all corresponding Rust fixture bytes equal final candidate.

validation.example_check: passed on main port with Rust1.95.0; pure library harness, no Unix-only APIs

limits: Synchronous Terminal::capture_for_owner timings only, without runtime scheduling, PTY I/O or rendering. Cold storage growth counts primary page allocations; excludes returned capture bytes, transient row vectors, screen-level maps, graphics and process RSS. Full captures remain proportional to requested history and restore all selected cold cells.
